descriptions.text: Hedy. Gremlin. Level 30 vehicle mechanic. This is an applicant to be manager of your garage. This is a non-combatant NPC. Hedy is an expert in all things mechanical. If you choose a mechanical-based vehicle, she will be in charge of your garage. Don't let her appearance fool you. She's about as experienced as one can get when it comes to engines. If you can limp your vehicle back to the garage, rest assured it'll be good as new by the time the next heat starts. Warning: Just because Hedy is a non-combatant NPC, it doesn't mean she's invulnerable. If something happens to her, your vehicle will not get repaired between heats. Hedy is not allowed to enter your safe room.

beats.headline: The garage comes with a mechanic
beats.text: Five thousand five hundred and one crawlers arrive, Crawler Donut takes the Assassin of Sekhmet class, and Crawler Donut picks the mechanical vehicle category, chiefly so that it will not eat Mongo. The category comes with an applicant. Hedy, gremlin, level thirty, and the terms attached to her that nobody reads: non-combatant, not invulnerable, not admitted to the safe room, and if anything happens to her the vehicle stops being repaired between heats. Crawler Donut takes her. The other applicant trains animals.

beats.headline: First trip to the garage
beats.text: They drive back into their own garage after the first heat, trailer and all, and are handed the particulars of the next race. Then Hedy puts the upgrade board up, recommends the spider legs above everything else on it, and they take Retractable Legs. I record the choice without comment, except to observe that a vehicle which can stand up is also a vehicle which can fall over.

beats.headline: Arms crossed at the garage door
beats.text: Between heats. The garage door goes up and Hedy is standing there with her arms crossed, and she would like to know what they did to her girl, and why last place. The particulars of the next race come through, and then the audience's upgrade vote, which she presents as a kindness to Princess Donut. Across the same garage Bucket Boy jumps out of the truck to tell Dong that he has seen Corcunda. The repairs get done regardless.

beats.headline: She picks the upgrades for them
beats.text: The upgrade board goes up again and Hedy walks the party through it again, subdued this time, because she can read the room. She has watched what this course does to a chassis. They have only felt it. Her advice is taken, which on the whole is more than the advice of anyone else in that garage that day managed.

beats.headline: Lost with the ice-cream truck
beats.text: Casualty notice. Hedy, gremlin, vehicle mechanic, who drove the ice-cream truck carrying the Faction Wars heads in the procession. The truck is in smoking pieces against the arena wall. Bigs delivers it plainly: we lost Hedy. Crawler Carl says ahh, hell. It was the first time she had been allowed out of the garage.
